name: contextbridge-chat
description: Copilot-style chat for Claude Code, Codex and GitHub Copilot CLI: attach context, ask questions and review changes.

contextBridge.provider.description: Provider that answers questions in workspaces where you haven't picked one in the chat. Once you pick in the chat, that choice is remembered for the workspace and takes precedence.

enumDescriptions: Answers only. The provider cannot modify workspace files.
Full provider capabilities. Claude Code asks in the chat before edits and commands; Codex can edit files and run commands inside the workspace.
contextBridge.mode.description: Whether the provider may change your files, in workspaces where you haven't picked a mode in the chat. Once you pick in the chat, that choice is remembered for the workspace and takes precedence.

enumDescriptions: Ask before each edit, command or tool call the provider requests.
Approve every request automatically. Each approval is still listed in the chat.
contextBridge.agent.defaultPermissions.description: Agent-mode permission level for new chats. You can change it per chat from the picker below the question box.

contextBridge.attachCurrentFile.description: Attach the file open in the editor to each question, like Copilot's current-file context. With text selected, the selection is sent instead of the whole file. Click × on its chip to turn it off for one chat.

contextBridge.claude.path.description: Path to the claude executable. Leave empty to find it automatically.

contextBridge.claude.model.markdownDescription: Claude Code model for new chats: an alias such as `opus` or `sonnet` (the latest model of that family), or a full model name. Empty uses Claude Code's own default. The model picker's choice is remembered per workspace and takes precedence.

contextBridge.claude.effort.markdownDescription: Claude Code effort level for new chats (`low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max`). Empty uses Claude Code's own default. The effort picker's choice is remembered per workspace and takes precedence.

contextBridge.codex.path.description: Path to the codex executable. Leave empty to find it automatically.

contextBridge.codex.model.markdownDescription: Codex model for new chats, as listed in the model picker. Empty uses Codex's own default (your Codex config). The model picker's choice is remembered per workspace and takes precedence.

contextBridge.codex.effort.markdownDescription: Codex reasoning effort for new chats, such as `low`, `medium` or `high` (the picker shows what each model supports). Empty uses Codex's own default. The effort picker's choice is remembered per workspace and takes precedence.

enumDescriptions: codex app-server: streams answers as they're written; Agent mode asks for approval in the chat. Experimental in the Codex CLI.
codex exec --json: whole messages only; Agent mode runs in the workspace-write sandbox without asking.
Search OpenAI's index of previously fetched pages (may be slightly out of date).
contextBridge.codex.webSearch.description: Codex's web search tool, in both Ask and Agent mode. Shell commands stay offline in Codex's sandbox either way. (Claude Code's web search is always available.)

contextBridge.history.maxChats.description: How many chats to keep per workspace (oldest are deleted first). 0 turns chat history off.

contextBridge.copilot.path.description: Path to the Copilot CLI executable if it is not found automatically.

contextBridge.copilot.model.description: Model for new Copilot chats. Empty uses the CLI's default. The model picker's choice is remembered per workspace and takes precedence.

contextBridge.copilot.effort.description: Reasoning effort for new Copilot chats. Empty uses the CLI's default; only supported efforts are offered. The effort picker's choice is remembered per workspace and takes precedence.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
